kind: descriptive development comparison (development evidence only; not a test, not a replicated biological comparison)
question: Which per-window local Calpha geometries differ between the AdK open-start and closed-start trajectories over a matched elapsed-time interval, and how stable is that description across time blocks?

dataset.confound: The runs differ in starting structure; equal elapsed time does not remove that confound. One run per starting condition.

observation_period.rule: common elapsed interval from each run's first timestamp: [0, min(last elapsed)] = [0, 335400] ps; every fourth source frame from frame 0 (cadence 200 ps in both, so samples every 800 ps); no burn-in removed
observation_period.verification: selected timestamps must be identical in both runs, equal 800 ps x k, and lie within [0, 335400] ps

blocks.rule: equal-duration blocks of [0, 335400] ps with edges at T/3 and 2T/3; a sample belongs to block b if edge_b <= t < edge_{b+1} (last block includes T); then every block of both runs is truncated to the smallest block size, keeping its earliest samples
blocks.comparisons: between-run: all 3 x 3 block pairs; within-run: the 3 block pairs of each run; all at the same block sample size. Full-run distances are reported separately and are not compared in magnitude with block distances.
blocks.interpretation: Blocks are not independent replicates. Fractions of between-run block distances above the largest within-run block distance are descriptive only.

measure.name: Jensen-Shannon distance = sqrt(Jensen-Shannon divergence)
measure.zero_counts: empty bins contribute 0 (0 log 0 = 0); no pseudocounts
measure.out_of_range: linear channels use explicit underflow and overflow bins appended to the histogram; counts reported
measure.identical_bins: the same bins for both runs and all blocks within a configuration

configurations.rule: primary declared in advance; sensitivity results are reported, never used to choose a configuration

matched_observations: a window enters a channel pair only if every selected sample is valid in both runs for both channels of that pair; exclusions are reported with reasons
physics_notes: kappa and the i->i+2 distance are near-deterministic functions of each other when Calpha-Calpha bond lengths are nearly constant: d^2 = l1^2 + l2^2 + 2 l1 l2 cos(kappa)
the i->i+3 distance depends on tau and two kappa values and is unchanged by tau -> -tau (it cannot see chirality)
marginal per-window distributions can miss changes in joint relationships between windows or features
outputs: per-window full-run JS distance per channel
block-level between/within distances and descriptive fractions
rank stability: Spearman between matched block-pair rankings within a channel; Spearman between paired channels
sensitivity: Spearman and top-10 overlap versus primary
